name: ABA Ethics / Attorney-Client AI Compliance
description: Multi-state attorney-client confidentiality framework based on ABA Model Rule 1.6 and ABA Formal Opinion 512. Covers the duty to protect 'information relating to the representation' when using generative AI tools. Applies to ~40+ jurisdictions that track the ABA framework including D.C. (Opinion 388) and Florida (Opinion 24-1).
